description: Dev predictions: benchmarks/results_v2/emotion/dev_probs_deployed.npy, produced by the exact deployed artifact (fp32 ONNX data/v2/emotion/models/g1_10k_fp32/model.onnx via OnnxPredictor, threads 8, batch 64) in the same run that wrote the frozen eval_probs.npy; re-prediction of 128 dev + 128 test inputs matched exactly (max abs diff 0). The model trained only on LLM-labeled pool texts, never on dev texts (dev half A informed the labeling guidance only), so dev predictions are out-of-sample. Method chosen by select_calibrator (5-fold stratified CV on the 200 dev, lowest NLL) restricted to none/temperature, refit on all 200. Restriction justified on dev: only these keep the top-1 label equal to the deployed decision; vector scaling had lower CV NLL (0.561 vs 0.615) but moved 4% of dev argmaxes and fits a per-class bias for 'surprise' from 2 dev examples; isotonic OvR was worst on NLL (0.890). Full 4-method table in dev_cv_all_methods.
